probeIp: audit IP (single host). Sucuri verdict is from THIS IP; production crawler IP should behave identically (same Sucuri Cloudproxy edge, UA-fingerprint-matched cookie) but re-confirm on first production solve.
method: Mirrors production waf-cookie-manager exactly: Playwright chromium (production stealth args) + iPhone UA (siteProfile.userAgentOverride) solves Sucuri JS challenge once on /shop/, extracts context.cookies(origin), reuses the cookie string in spaced axios GETs (>=2.5s gap, maxRedirects=0). Challenge detector = status 307/403/503 OR body contains 'sucuri_cloudproxy_js'. STOP rule = 2 consecutive challenges. Scripts: backend/scripts/_tmp-gotenda-r2-reach.ts (19 req) + backend/scripts/_tmp-gotenda-r2-detail.ts (3 detail pages).

evidence.solve: Single Playwright navigation to /shop/ landed on https://www.gotenda.com/shop/ (200, no challenge interstitial) and yielded 15 cookies including sucuri_cloudproxy_uuid_f2f1c7d20. No CAPTCHA gate encountered.
evidence.sustainedWalk: 22 total spaced requests (19 mixed + 3 detail-page), ALL returned HTTP 200, ZERO Sucuri challenges (0/22). One solved cookie held across the entire ~85s walk. No 307/403/503, no sucuri_cloudproxy_js body re-injection at any step.

evidence.perRequestLatencyMs: 52-4965 (HTML category archive pages slowest ~3-5s; API ~2-2.5s); no latency escalation trend that would indicate edge throttling.
evidence.budgetFit: Held baseBudget=1800/hr => ~2s effective gap. Probe ran at 2.5s gaps with no rate-limit/escalation. At 16786 products / perPage=24 HTML = ~700 pages; or via Store API per_page=100 = ~168 pages. Either fits comfortably within a 1800/hr budget across a maintain cycle.

caveats: Cookie TTL: production waf-cookie-manager refreshes conservatively at 90 min (COOKIE_TTL_MS); DB profile claims Sucuri TTL 30 min. Cookie survived the full ~85s walk; long-cycle TTL not exhaustively tested but the 90-min refresh + reportFailure() eviction (2 failures) path already handles expiry.

Verdict is from the audit IP. Sucuri Cloudproxy is per-host and UA-fingerprint-bound; production must solve with the SAME iPhone UA override (it does - waf-cookie-manager.ts:106 resolveWafUa reads siteProfile.userAgentOverride). If production uses PLAYWRIGHT_UA (Chrome) instead, the cookie binds to a different fingerprint - confirm the iPhone override is loaded.
Rapid-burst (<2s) NOT tested by design (ban-risk rule). Verdict covers the >=2s spaced crawl the production scheduler actually performs.

notes: VERDICT: SAFE-TO-ENABLE. Single Sucuri solve via iPhone-UA Playwright (production path) yields a cookie that holds across a 22-request spaced (>=2.5s) mixed walk with 0 re-challenges, 0 escalation, no rate-limit. Production waf-cookie-manager refreshes at 90 min and self-heals via reportFailure eviction. All four R1-deferred 'inconclusive' items (sustained walk, sort note, runtime fetchability, sub-cat coverage via /shop/) are resolved in favor of enabling. Recommend operator ENABLE gotenda.
